title: Joe Oliver and her maiden name
summary: Toyama asks about Joe Oliver; she recalls he was from near Donaldsonville, and gives her maiden name.

blocks.x: Joe Oliver. Your husband, Joe Oliver.
Joe Oliver. I tell you, I don't forgot to write down some kind of the name of the people. Oh, he.
He was a, he had a bad eye too. He played the cornet. He was born there.
Well, I guess I'm going in. Yeah, he was from Bernside.
Oh, I know that one side he called. That's somewhere, it was on outside the river there.

Yeah, he didn't. He was with the central there. Up near Donaldsonville, in Central, I think. I'm not sure, but I get all confused. I don't get out that much. I said I don't know how to forget about the police here. Yeah. Because after my mother died, I don't know how to do that.
What was your name before you married? Argus. I'm going to be with Joseph Argus.
